trigger_cases.prompt: Choose the best chart to compare regional revenue trends over the past 8 quarters.
Audit our KPI executive dashboard for perceptual accuracy and axis integrity.
Design an accessible, colorblind-friendly data visualization for customer retention cohorts.
Write a Dockerfile for deploying a Node.js microservice.

binary_cases.prompt: Design a bar chart to compare discrete sales figures across 5 product lines.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Starts quantitative bar axis at zero, uses direct labeling, and avoids 3D or dual-axis distortions.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Use a horizontal bar chart with a zero baseline on the x-axis, direct value labels, and sorting by magnitude.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Truncate the bar chart y-axis at 90% to exaggerate differences and render in 3D perspective.
